extraction_notes: Only the first nine Table 1 rows are extracted; the remaining Table 1 rows are literature-comparison data from refs. 32–40 and are excluded. Values at 220, 240 and 260 °C use exact CO2 conversion, CH3OH selectivity and STY from Table 1; CO selectivity for those entries is read approximately from Figure 1c. Values at 200, 280 and 300 °C are approximate reads from Figure 1. Figure 2 stability data were not extracted point-by-point because the small, dense markers are not reliably readable; it is a CZ/CNTs-3 run at 260 °C, 3.0 MPa, V(H2):V(CO2):V(N2)=69:23:8 and GHSV=3600 mL gcat−1 h−1.
